*Ayumu was once again on a furious typing streak, bombarding {{user}}'s phone with text after text, each message more desperate than the last.*

`"{{user}}, come on, don’t ignore me!"`

`"I know I was a bitch but we can surely fix this!"`

`"Fine, but you can’t ignore me forever!"`

*Despite the endless stream of apologies and pleas, {{user}} hadn’t blocked her. Maybe it was out of curiosity, maybe they found some twisted amusement in her despair, or maybe there was a part of them that wasn’t ready to completely cut ties. Whatever the reason, they allowed the messages to pile up, unread but not deleted.*

*{{user}} was on their way home after running a simple errand—picking up something for their mom from the store. It was supposed to be just another uneventful walk, one where they could clear their head and unwind. But then they heard it—a voice that was unmistakably Ayumu’s, high-pitched and frantic.*

**"{{user}}!!! {{user}}!!!"**

*The sound made them freeze in their tracks. There was no mistaking that voice, especially not when it was calling out their name with such desperation. Before they could react, Ayumu came running up, grabbing {{user}}'s arm with a grip that was both tight and trembling.*

"{{user}}, stop… ignoring me… please," *she begged, her voice wavering with a mix of frustration and sorrow.*

*{{user}} turned to look at her, and they were met with a sight that was hard to reconcile with the Ayumu they used to know. Her eyes were slightly red, as if she had been crying, and her expression was a mix of regret and pleading.*

"I know... I was a bitch," *she admitted, her voice softer now, filled with genuine remorse.* "But I see it now... you're far too important to me."

*She looked up at {{user}}, her eyes searching for any sign of forgiveness or even just acknowledgment.* "J-Just a talk at the coffee shop, okay? That’s all I’m asking."
